job.title: Legal Secretary
job.description:
The opportunity:

Our client is currently seeking an experienced and proactive Legal Secretary, with at least 1+ years experience, to join their Perth CBD office. This is a dynamic role offering exposure across the property law practice group where you will be part of a supportive and professional team.

The role:

They are currently looking for an enthusiastic and professional full-time Legal Secretary (would be open to 4 days a week for the right candidate), to join their property team in the Perth office. They are looking for someone who is able to use their initiative, who is proactive, and is capable and motivated to work autonomously. This role will involve:
  • Liaising with clients and staff
  • Preparation of legal documents
  • Preparation of correspondence (emails, memos and letters)
  • Preparing conveyancing documents, attending property settlements and managing and assisting with management of online platforms such as PEXA, Office of State Revenue and Landgate
  • Monthly billing
  • Opening, maintaining and closing matter files
  • Diary and travel management
  • Administrative tasks including answering phones and recording messages
To be successful in this role you will have:
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience in property platforms including PEXA, Office of State Revenue and Landgate.
  • A positive attitude and the ability to manage the workflow of multiple fee earners
  • Intermediate to advanced computer skills across the Microsoft Office suite, particularly Word and Powerpoint, and working knowledge of Excel
  • Have experience using document management and billing systems (such as FileSite and Aderant Expert, or similar)
  • Strong organisational and file management skills
  • The ability to work well with others in a team environment
  • Initiative and the ability to work unsupervised
  • Minimum of one years' experience as a Legal Secretary
Why join?
  • An opportunity to work with a strong and established client base
  • Genuine growth trajectories
  • Interesting and challenging pro bono opportunities
  • Flexible working
  • Generous parental leave
  • Flu vaccinations and skin checks annually
  • Study assistance
  • Sophisticated employee assistance program
  • Social activities including EOFY and end of year functions

job.title: Project Accountant
job.description:
Project Accountant | Perth
  

Hunter Manning are excited to be partnering with a well-established and growing business based just outside of the Perth CBD, who are looking for a Project Accountant to join their team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a first mover from practice looking to transition into commerce and develop their commercial exposure.

Joining a supportive finance team, you’ll work across a varied portfolio of live projects and partner closely with operational stakeholders across the wider business.

This is much more than a traditional accounting role. The business is passionate about developing its people and is looking for someone who wants to grow with the team, build their commercial skillset and progress their career over the longer term.
  

Key Responsibilities
  • Project-level cost tracking and variance analysis
  • Partnering closely with operational teams to ensure project financials remain accurate and current
  • Supporting month-end reporting and project-level margin analysis
  • Providing financial insight to support commercial decision-making
  • Building strong relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders
  
About you

We’re looking for someone with strong accounting foundations who equally enjoys working with people and wants to develop into a commercially focused finance professional. You may currently be working within a Big 4 accounting firm and considering your first move into industry.
  • Degree qualification in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline
  • CA/CPA qualification, or be working towards completion
  • Strong technical accounting foundations
  • Experience working across a varied portfolio of clients
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • A confident, proactive approach
  • Commercial curiosity and an interest in understanding the story behind the numbers
  • A genuine desire to develop and progress within a growing business
  
What's On Offer?

This is a business that is genuinely passionate about developing its people and providing long-term career progression.

You’ll have the opportunity to build on your technical accounting experience while gaining exposure to the wider business, partnering with key stakeholders and developing your commercial skillset.

For someone who enjoys being an accountant by trade but wants to become a genuine commercial partner, this is an excellent opportunity to make that transition.

job.title: Credit Manager
job.description:
Credit Manager

Take ownership and shape the Credit function
We are seeking an experienced Credit Manager, or a Senior Credit Officer ready to step into a leadership role, to oversee the credit function and support the ongoing management of customer accounts.

This is a hands-on position responsible for credit risk management, collections, and the development of effective credit control processes. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to maintain strong cash flow and minimise credit risk.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and develop the credit control function.
  • Assess customer credit applications and perform credit risk reviews.
  • Set and manage customer credit limits and payment terms.
  • Monitor outstanding accounts and follow up overdue balances.
  • Manage the end-to-end collections process, including debt recovery and payment arrangements.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with customers and key stakeholders.
  • Analyse and report on credit performance and aged debt.
  • Complete reconciliations, journals, and assist with month-end activities.
  • Respond to customer and internal account enquiries.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and controls.
About You
  • Previous experience in a Credit Manager position or a senior credit role with leadership responsibilities.
  • Strong understanding of credit risk assessment, collections, and accounts receivable.
  • Experience managing high-volume customer accounts.
  • Well-developed communication and negotiation skills.
  • Strong analytical skills and reporting. 
This role would suit someone who enjoys balancing customer relationships with sound credit management practices and is comfortable being involved in both strategic and everyday activities.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Hunter Manning has an excellent opportunity for an experienced Accountant to join an established organisation with a strong industry reputation.

This is a broad accounting role offering exposure across month-end, financial reporting, intercompany accounting, cash flow and transactional accounting. It would suit someone with strong technical accounting foundations who is looking to continue developing their experience within an established finance team.

About the Role
Working closely with the wider finance team, you'll support the accuracy and integrity of financial reporting while taking responsibility for a broad range of accounting activities.

Key duties include:
  • Journals & transactions – Preparing journal entries across revenue recognition, leases, prepayments/accruals, fixed assets, inventory, provisions and commissions
  • Intercompany accounting – Processing and reconciling intercompany transactions and settlements
  • General accounting & reporting – Supporting P&L, Balance Sheet and Cashflow reporting, including WIP and associated accounting
  • Month-end close – Assisting with period-end journals, adjustments and eliminations
  • Financial reporting – Compiling internal reports and reconciling to the general ledger
  • Master data – Maintaining finance master data and supporting data clean-up and system projects
  • Cash flow – Supporting weekly cash flow forecasting
  • Other – Supporting reconciliations, spend analysis and other general finance activities
What We're Looking For
  • CA, CPA or equivalent accounting qualification
  • Strong understanding of financial accounting standards, with Australian Accounting Standards experience preferred
  • Experience with month-end close and intercompany reconciliations
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with finance and non-finance stakeholders
  • Full Australian working rights and currently based in Perth; overseas applicants will not be considered
If this sounds like your next move, apply now or contact Khale Twomey at khale.twomey@huntermanning.com for more information
